text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said on Tuesday it downgraded Pioneer Financial Services Inc to long-term market performer from long-term outperformer.
--It continues to rate the company a market performer in the intermediate term.
-- Shares were trading at 1/8 at 24-1/2 in midafternoon trading.
--Pioneer shares surged on Monday after Pioneer and Conseco Inc agreed to a merger, under which Conseco would acquire Pioneer for Conseco stock valued between $25 and $28 per Pioneer share.
--Pioneer closed up 5-1/2 at 24-1/2 in compositie trading on Monday.
--EVEREN analyst Frederick Sandburg said he in turn raised his six-month and 18-month price objectives each to $28 from $21 and $24, respectively.
--At yesterday's market close, however, Pioneer was just nine percent below its share equivalent value, prompting him to downgrade the stock to market performer, Sandburg said.
